message:
Merge pull request #1 from TytanTSS/main-ikqxrc

Add release automation and version management

fix: English text for -version flag, gofmt i18n test

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01FDgMJHytYcpDX48asCmyBV

ci: automated builds and GitHub releases for Windows, macOS and Linux

- release.yml: on a v* tag (or manual run) tests on all three OSes, builds
  windows-amd64/arm64, macos-universal, linux-amd64 and linux-server-amd64
  archives, smoke-tests them with -version, publishes the release with
  SHA256SUMS and install notes
- ci.yml: gofmt, go vet and tests on every push and pull request
- scripts/package.sh: one archive per target, usable locally
- -version flag, set from the tag at build time
- Windows: restore the console that Ebitengine frees when ratas.exe is
  started by double-click, so the terminal mode works from Explorer
